alt_text: Five panels comparing vep-rs v1.0.0 and fastVEP v0.6.2 against Ensembl VEP 116.3. (a) Raw F1 per dataset as a bar for each of vep-rs and fastVEP, with each tool's adjusted F1 as a marker joined to the end of the bar by a line where the two differ. (b) Wall time per dataset and architecture of vep-rs, fastVEP and Ensembl VEP, a circle each, filled for ARM and open for x86; from left to right, the circles of every dataset and architecture are those of vep-rs, fastVEP and Ensembl VEP; each dataset, or each separately timed part of one, is timed in 1 run for Ensembl VEP, against 5 for vep-rs and fastVEP. Ensembl VEP's wall times are Ensembl VEP 116.2's figures, carried forward from the earlier reference generation. The concordance panels compare against Ensembl VEP 116.3's output. (c) Raw F1 per plugin (plugins verified on real data; TranscriptAnnotator on its committed table; plugins whose data cannot be redistributed on synthetic fixtures, marked synthetic) as a bar for each of vep-rs and fastVEP, with each tool's adjusted F1 as a marker joined to the end of the bar by a line where the two differ: fastVEP has a figure on 14 of the 58 rows, its marker on 12 of them, and a cross (no such source) on 44; vep-rs's adjusted F1 is exactly 1 on 58 of the 58 rows. (d) The plugins read by vep-rs and fastVEP, a bar each: 31 of 31 and 7 of 31. (e) The ready-made Ensembl VEP caches that are exact, of those checked: a bar for vep-rs, labelled 34,289 of 34,289; for fastVEP a cross (reads no Ensembl VEP transcript cache) and no bar. By set, exact of checked: species caches 1,286 of 1,286, bacterial and archaeal genomes 31,289 of 31,289, fungal and protist collection genomes 1,625 of 1,625 and human pangenome assemblies 89 of 89. fastVEP v0.6.2's documentation says that its gene models come from a GFF3 file and that it reads no Ensembl VEP transcript cache, so it has no counterpart in this panel, where a cross stands in its row. A marker standing at the end of its bar means that the tool's raw and adjusted F1 are equal as drawn. On a row of a plugin verified on real data, vep-rs's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage), except on gnomADMt GRCh38 (ClinVar alone); fastVEP's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage). The plugin panel's 58 rows carry 33 row names for 31 plugins: CADD is scored under CADD and CADD (structural variants) and LoFTEE is scored under LoFTEE (synthetic conservation data) and LoFTEE. A row's figure sums the per-feature entries that the record holds for the tool on the row's own dataset or corpus, each scored by itself, and the tools differ in the number of those entries on 4 rows: dbNSFP GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 5, fastVEP 1), dbNSFP GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 9, fastVEP 1), SpliceAI GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1) and SpliceAI GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1). An F1 of exactly 1 has no place on a scale of 1 - F1: it is drawn where the axis reads 1, past a break in the axis line, and 67 of the 67 adjusted markers of vep-rs stand there. The plugin panel runs over both columns: its groups from Synthetic fixtures (data that cannot be redistributed) on continue in the second column, under the same title.
caption: **vep-rs v1.0.0 against Ensembl VEP 116.3, with fastVEP v0.6.2 as comparator.** (a) Raw F1 per dataset on a log(1 - F1) axis; a marker is its tool's adjusted F1, joined to the end of its bar by a line where the two differ. All six is the pool of the six whole-genome datasets, the ClinVar and the population datasets. (b) Wall time per dataset and architecture: a ClinVar line is the median of its runs, any other the sum of the medians of its dataset's separately timed parts (the record's methodology note: "a dataset's figure is the sum of its per-chromosome medians"); each dataset, or each separately timed part of one, is timed in 1 run for Ensembl VEP, against 5 for vep-rs and fastVEP. Ensembl VEP's wall times are Ensembl VEP 116.2's figures, carried forward from the earlier reference generation. The concordance panels compare against Ensembl VEP 116.3's output. (c) Raw F1 per plugin: plugins verified on real data; TranscriptAnnotator on its committed table; plugins whose data cannot be redistributed on synthetic fixtures, marked synthetic. On a row of a plugin verified on real data, vep-rs's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage), except on gnomADMt GRCh38 (ClinVar alone); fastVEP's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage). The bar is each tool's per-feature raw F1, the marker its tool's adjusted F1, joined to the end of its bar by a line where the two differ, as in (a); a cross marks a plugin for which the comparator has no counterpart ("no such source"). LoFTEE's reference ran with stand-ins for the MaxEntScan files its module bundles, on the Ensembl VEP image with samtools added. (d) The plugins each tool reads, of the 31 that vep-rs supports: vep-rs 31 and fastVEP 7; plugins vep-rs does not port are not counted and are listed by reason in the README. (e) The ready-made Ensembl VEP caches that are exact, of those checked: 34,289 of 34,289. The bar counts the caches on which vep-rs's output reads exact on the genome check's generated input, of those checked against the stored output of Ensembl VEP 116.3. By set, exact of checked: species caches 1,286 of 1,286, bacterial and archaeal genomes 31,289 of 31,289, fungal and protist collection genomes 1,625 of 1,625 and human pangenome assemblies 89 of 89. fastVEP v0.6.2's documentation says that its gene models come from a GFF3 file and that it reads no Ensembl VEP transcript cache, so it has no counterpart in this panel, where a cross stands in its row. The plugin panel's 58 rows carry 33 row names for 31 plugins: CADD is scored under CADD and CADD (structural variants) and LoFTEE is scored under LoFTEE (synthetic conservation data) and LoFTEE. A row's figure sums the per-feature entries that the record holds for the tool on the row's own dataset or corpus, each scored by itself, and the tools differ in the number of those entries on 4 rows: dbNSFP GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 5, fastVEP 1), dbNSFP GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 9, fastVEP 1), SpliceAI GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1) and SpliceAI GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1). On an F1 axis a value is a place, not a length: every bar starts at the left edge of its plot, left of where an F1 of 0 stands, and ends at the place of its F1. A marker standing at the end of its bar means that the tool's raw and adjusted F1 are equal as drawn. On a comparator's adjusted F1 the record's note reads: "The adjusted figure sets aside the same documented classes as for vep-rs; where the engine produces none of their shapes it equals the raw one." fastVEP's adjusted F1 is left out where no record holds its adjusted counts. An F1 of exactly 1 has no place on a scale of 1 - F1: it is drawn where the axis reads 1, past a break in the axis line, and 67 of the 67 adjusted markers of vep-rs stand there. vep-rs matches Ensembl VEP exactly except for the documented divergences. Every value is in the records listed under Provenance records.
